description: JStock is open showing the Stock Watchlist with AAPL, MSFT, GOOGL, AMZN, and NVDA. Your task is to export the current watchlist to a CSV file and save it to the Desktop as 'watchlist_export.csv'. To export: go to File > Save As..., which opens a Save dialog already set to CSV format. In the dialog, navigate to the Desktop folder, change the filename to 'watchlist_export', and click Save. The exported CSV file should appear on the Desktop as 'watchlist_export.csv'.
